fields.Name: T342 - Labels Search Narrows With No-Results Reset
fields.Description: Exercises client-side applyFilters over name/description/entity and the IsListNarrowed-driven empty-state CTA (onEmptyStateAction toggling between reset and create) — logic local to this component.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Labels surface, type an unlikely string like 'zzzqqx' into the 'Search labels...' box and confirm the list narrows and a 'No labels found' no-results state appears with a Reset action. Then trigger the Reset (or clear the search) and confirm the labels list (or base empty state) returns. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. The search responding is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the search box responsively narrows the labels list
A non-matching query produces a 'No labels found' no-results state with a Reset action
Resetting or clearing the search restores the labels list or the base empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
